purpose.zh: 在拉长位加强大腿前侧
purpose.en: Strengthen the front of your thighs in a lengthened position.

text.zh: 膝到肩一条直线，向后倾到可控范围
text.en: Keep a line from knees to shoulders and lean back as far as you control

text.zh: 跪立夹紧臀部，双手交叉放胸前
text.en: Kneel tall, squeeze your glutes and cross your arms on your chest.
Do not bend at the hips, then return upright.

commonErrors.en: Bending at the hips and sitting back.
Leaning back too far to return.

cautions.zh: 膝前不适时减小后倾幅度，可在膝下加垫
cautions.en: Lean back less if the front of your knee feels uncomfortable, and pad under your knees.
